verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bolna is built around APIs, CLI, and MCP server for defining agents and multi-step outreach sequences (bolna-docs-12, bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-17), but there is no mention of a visual/no-code builder with branching, states, or handoffs; workflows are described as 'driven entirely through the Bolna API.' Missing for 10: any visual flow-builder UI, drag-and-drop branching/state design, no-code handoff configuration.
